subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a current-main Docker reproduction before authorizing a fix PR for this heartbeat routing report?
rationale: The reporter's latest-release evidence is credible, but current source already contains the prior stale-runtime fix and the exact remaining dropped-agent path is not identified from source alone.

options.title: Require current-main live repro
options.body: Run the reporter's Docker multi-agent setup against current main and identify whether the scheduled heartbeat path, manual wake path, or runtime reload path drops the secondary agent target before queuing a fix.

options.title: Authorize narrow repair now
options.body: Allow a repair PR to target the most likely gateway cron target resolver path immediately, accepting that the first PR may miss a different live entry path.

recommendation.title: Require current-main live repro
recommendation.body: Run the reporter's Docker multi-agent setup against current main and identify whether the scheduled heartbeat path, manual wake path, or runtime reload path drops the secondary agent target before queuing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the closest shipped resolver fix and are the best history-backed owner for deciding whether the remaining evidence is enough to proceed without a live repro.
